title: Director of Operational Excellence
text:
**Director of Operational Excellence**

**LOCATION:**
Plano, TX – Dallas area

**TRAVEL:**
25-50%

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Our client is seeking a Director of Operational Excellence to join their growing organization. The Director of OpEx/CI is responsible for developing, leading, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives across multiple manufacturing facilities. This role drives operational excellence by leading Lean and other CI initiatives focused on improving productivity, reducing waste, enhancing quality, and standardizing best practices. The Director partners closely with plant leadership teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement at every level.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Designing and implementing Continuous Improvement strategies across four manufacturing sites
* Ensuring Lean training and events align with corporate goals in productivity, safety, quality, and sustainability
* Improving process flow, eliminating waste, and increasing operational efficiency
* Conducting operational assessments to identify opportunities for process optimization, cost reduction, and efficiency improvements
* Facilitating events and deploying Lean tools such as Kaizen events, Value Stream Mapping, 5S, SMED, and root cause analysis
* Standardizing CI tools, training, and metrics across all facilities including scorecards and KPIs, ensuring consistent application and measurable results
* Reporting metrics and KPI improvements to senior leadership
* Coaching and mentoring CI leaders and operations personnel at each site to build local capabilities in Lean
* Driving problem solving culture across the organization
* Collaborating with Plant Managers and cross-functional teams to integrate Lean efforts with business goals
* Sharing best practices across site and encouraging a knowledge-sharing environment to accelerate results
* Supporting the implementation of automation, layout improvements, and digital transformation initiatives to improve legacy manufacturing operations

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelors Degree in Engineering or related field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in manufacturing environments including 3+ years in a CI leadership role
* Proven experience utilizing and deploying Lean tools including Value Stream Mapping, KPI development, Transactional Process Improvement, Strategy Deployment, 6S, Standard Work, FMEA, Problem Solving, Kanban, Visual Daily Management, 80/20, etc.
* Understanding of manufacturing cost and P&L; proven experience delivering measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and cost
* Strong project management skills and ability to lead cross-functional teams remotely or onsite
* Proficiency with data analysis, KPIs, and manufacturing systems (ERP, MES, etc.)

Lean Focus LLC is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or protected Veteran status.

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

At Lean Focus, we help businesses overcome their biggest challenges by transforming them for the better, and for the long-term. A "who's who" of global leaders in every industry, our clients include some of the world's most respected brands and several members of the Fortune 1000.
